### UC Davis Health OpenAI access

For lab members affiliated with UC Davis Health (UCDH)
or conducting health sciences research,
enterprise OpenAI accounts are provisioned
through the UCDH IT Self-Service (ITSS) ServiceNow catalog.

To request an account:

1. Navigate to the [UCDH ServiceNow OpenAI catalog item](https://ucdh.service-now.com/itss?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=738dd2ac93eba650c4dbb1847aba100d).
2. Log in with your UC Davis Health credentials and complete Duo two-factor authentication if prompted.
3. Fill out the request form with your department, contact details, and business or research justification.
4. Submit the request for processing by UCDH IT.
5. Once approved, follow the instructions in the confirmation email to join the UC Davis Health OpenAI workspace.

### UC Davis campus OpenAI access

For UC Davis campus affiliates,
access to ChatGPT Edu is managed through Information and Educational Technology (IET) Aggie AI.
See the [IET Aggie AI ChatGPT Edu documentation](https://iet.ucdavis.edu/aggie-ai/ai-tools/chatgpt-edu)
for setup instructions and eligibility details.

### Data security and compliance

When using institutional AI accounts:

- Never submit Protected Health Information (PHI), personally identifiable information (PII), or restricted research data to AI tools unless authorized under an approved protocol.
- Follow all institutional data handling policies and the lab's guidelines on [Working with AI](https://morrison-lab.github.io/wai/chapters/ai-use-policies.html).
